name: Ring of Invisibility

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Turn Invisible
powers.text: Magic action: you're Invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or end it as a Bonus Action.

summary: A Magic action makes you Invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or choose to appear.
text: A Magic action with this ring grants you the Invisible condition. It lasts until you cast a spell, make an attack roll, take off the ring, or spend a Bonus Action to reappear.
